While the party recently secured five seats in Legislative Council polls, political analysts caution that rhetoric must be matched with concrete policy proposals, such as welfare boards, to secure lasting electoral gains.

articles.headline: Cyclone Murasu approaches Andhra Pradesh coast with red alerts issued
articles.title: Cyclone ‘Murasu’ drums up fresh worry for Andhra after Arnab; red alert sounded in five districts
articles.summary: Cyclone Murasu is projected to strike the south coast between Nellore and Narsapur on the night of November 2, 2026, bringing winds up to 120 kmph. The India Meteorological Department issued red alerts for five districts as the state struggles to recover from Cyclone Arnab, which recently caused five deaths and widespread infrastructure damage.
articles.description: Cyclone Murasu is likely to cross the coast between Nellore and Narsapur on the night of November 2-3 as a severe cyclonic storm

articles.headline: Mamata Banerjee supports CJP and Gen Z at INDIA bloc rally
articles.title: At INDIA bloc rally, Mamata extends support to CJP, Gen Z; says Bengal victim of SIR
articles.summary: Trinamool Congress chief Mamata Banerjee addressed the INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1, 2026, expressing solidarity with CJP leadership and Gen Z activists. She accused the BJP of manipulating elections through the Special Intensive Revision exercise, criticised Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, and called for united opposition against the ruling party.
articles.description: Taking a swipe at the SIR exercise, Mamata Banerjee described it as Special Intensive Relief to a party like the BJP

articles.headline: Champai Soren condemns alleged rape of woman inside Jharkhand police station
articles.title: Rape of woman inside police station, ‘repulsive image of jungle raj’ in Jharkhand: Champai Soren
articles.summary: Former Jharkhand Chief Minister Champai Soren criticised the alleged rape of a woman inside Gamharia police station in Seraikela-Kharswan district on November 1, 2026. The accused policeman, Niraj Lakra, was arrested, and five officers including station in-charge Sanjay Prasad were suspended for negligence after the victim was assaulted following a domestic dispute.
articles.description: The accused policeman, Niraj Lakra, has been arrested, and five policemen, including the officer-in-charge of Gamharia police station, Sanjay Prasad, were suspended on charges of dereliction of duty and negligence

articles.headline: Australian batsman Glenn Maxwell announces international cricket retirement
articles.title: Australia’s Glenn Maxwell calls time on international career
articles.summary: Australian cricketer Glenn Maxwell has announced his retirement from international competition after being omitted from the squad for the upcoming Twenty20 series against England. The 38-year-old all-rounder finished his career as Australia's third-highest run-scorer in Twenty20 internationals, having previously retired from one-day and Test cricket.
articles.description: Glenn Maxwell, who had not played a Test since 2017, called time on his one-day career last year but kept the door open for T20s

articles.headline: Cyclone Murasu forms over Bay of Bengal and threatens Andhra Pradesh
articles.title: Cyclone ‘Murasu’ forms over Bay of Bengal, southern Odisha on high alert
articles.summary: Deep depression over the Bay of Bengal intensified into cyclonic storm Murasu on November 1, 2026. The India Meteorological Department forecasts landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast by November 3 with severe winds. Odisha disaster management officials ordered evacuations and issued high alerts across the southern region anticipating heavy rainfall from November 2 onward.
articles.description: The IMD said cyclone ‘Murasu’ is likely to make landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast on November 3

articles.headline: German cost of living protests turn violent
articles.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
articles.summary: Demonstrations organised by the campaign group Gen Z regelt over living costs, school underfunding, and military service turned violent in Frankfurt, Berlin, Cologne, and Hamburg. Police used water cannons as rioters looted shops, smashed windows, and targeted emergency workers with fireworks and stones. Hesse interior minister Roman Poseck condemned the infiltration of left-wing extremists into the protests.
articles.description: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.

articles.headline: Nationalist Congress Party leaders express internal discontent
articles.title: NCP leaders express discontent in core committee meeting after talks with Amit Shah
articles.summary: Senior Nationalist Congress Party leaders expressed strong discontent with party leadership during a core committee meeting called by Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar on November 2, 2026. This followed a meeting with Union Home Minister Amit Shah to discuss concerns regarding the authoritarian functioning of Sunetra Pawar and Parth Pawar following the death of Ajit Pawar.
articles.description: A day before the core committee meeting, six senior NCP leaders met Amit Shah on Sunday night and is learnt to have informed him about their unhappiness with the party’s functioning under Sunetra Pawar and Parth Pawar

articles.headline: Thousands demonstrate in New Delhi demanding election chief resign
articles.title: Thousands rally in New Delhi to demand India’s election chief resign
articles.summary: Thousands of protesters marched in New Delhi on November 1, 2026, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over controversial electoral roll revisions. Led by Indian National Congress politician Rahul Gandhi, the demonstration at Ramlila Maidan followed weeks of unrest sparked by the removal of over 130 million names from voter lists, which critics argue disproportionately targets minorities.
articles.description: Hundreds of police, some carrying batons and shields, are deployed around the rally site.

articles.headline: M.Y. Tarigami criticizes ongoing CID clearance difficulties for Kashmiri citizens
articles.title: Despite court rulings, people continue to face difficulty in CID clearance: M.Y. Tarigami
articles.summary: Communist Party of India Marxist leader and lawmaker M.Y. Tarigami stated that citizens in Kashmir continue experiencing significant obstacles obtaining Criminal Investigation Department security clearances despite multiple favourable court rulings. According to the legislator, verification processes frequently penalise younger generations for the alleged past activities of distant or deceased relatives, unfairly restricting their future opportunities.
articles.description: Mohammad Yousuf Tarigami said that in some cases, those accused died many years ago, but their past continues to affect their families, denying the younger generations opportunities through no fault of their own

articles.headline: Iranian officials discuss diplomatic proposals with Qatari mediators
articles.title: Mediators continue US-Iran negotiations amid war rhetoric: What we know
articles.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced that officials are discussing a two-day plan with Qatari mediators in Doha to reopen the Strait of Hormuz amid ongoing military tensions with the United States. While expressing openness to dialogue if Washington lifts recent sanctions and reduces regional military presence, Iranian leaders warned that armed forces remain fully prepared for renewed conflict.
articles.description: Trump says latest talks 'going fine'; Iranian leaders say they favour diplomacy but are ready to respond to US attacks.

articles.headline: Indonesian wildfires cause toxic haze and diplomatic tensions across Southeast Asia
articles.title: Indonesia's toxic haze is giving its neighbours a political headache
articles.summary: Toxic haze from wildfires in Kalimantan, Papua, and Sumatra has drifted into Singapore and Malaysia, causing respiratory illnesses and political friction. Singaporean and Malaysian officials faced mounting citizen frustration over the crisis. Singapore and Indonesia announced a joint task force after foreign minister Vivian Balakrishnan met President Prabowo Subianto in Jakarta to address the transboundary pollution.
articles.description: Governments in Singapore and Malaysia are split between anxious citizens and an irascible neighbour.

articles.headline: Petronet LNG posts 53.2 percent profit increase despite supply disruptions
articles.title: Petronet LNG reports 52.3% growth in net profits, in talks for availing undelivered cargoes
articles.summary: State-owned Petronet LNG announced a net profit of 1,235 crore rupees for the September-end quarter, driven by operational efficiency despite ongoing supply disruptions from Qatar due to West Asian conflict. Akshay Kumar Singh, chairman and managing director, stated the firm is negotiating for undelivered cargoes. The importer processed 231 trillion British Thermal Units during the period, while total revenue declined to 7,200.35 crore rupees.
articles.description: Along with their results, Petronet LNG also declared a dividend of ₹7 per equity share

articles.headline: Powerful storm tears through beach resort on Italy’s southern coast
articles.title: Powerful storm tears through beach resort on Italy’s southern coast
articles.description: Surveillance footage captured the moment a tornado ripped through a beach resort restaurant in Castellaneta Marina

articles.headline: India cuts petrol export duty to nil and raises diesel levy
articles.title: Petrol export duty cut to nil, diesel levy raised by ₹3 a litre
articles.summary: The Indian government reduced export duty on petrol to nil on October 31, 2026, while increasing levies on diesel and aviation turbine fuel by three rupees and fifty paise per litre respectively. The fortnightly adjustment aims to ensure domestic fuel availability amidst global supply constraints. Data from analytics provider Kpler indicated that national diesel exports reached seven hundred thousand barrels per day in October.
articles.description: The government’s fortnightly review raised the export levy on diesel to ₹11.5 per litre from ₹8.5 and on aviation turbine fuel to ₹11 per litre from ₹10.5, while India’s diesel exports touched 700 kilo barrels per day in October, the highest since September 2025, according to Kpler

articles.headline: Qatari liquefied natural gas carrier struck by unidentified objects in Gulf
articles.title: Qatar LNG carrier struck by ‘unidentified objects’ in Gulf
articles.summary: Unidentified objects struck the Al Mayeda liquefied natural gas carrier in the Gulf, according to the Qatar Gas Transport Company. The vessel suffered no crew injuries or environmental damage and remains operational. This incident follows more than one hundred commercial ship attacks since the United States and Israel conflict with Iran began in February.
articles.description: Qatar Gas Transport Company says no injuries or environmental damage.

articles.headline: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urges affluent citizens to surrender free electricity
articles.title: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary’s appeal to give up free electricity triggers row
articles.summary: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary appealed on November 2, 2026, for taxpayers and well-off residents to voluntarily relinquish the state's 125 units of free electricity to fund educational development. The policy, provided under the Mukhyamantri Vidhyut Upbhokta Sahayata Yojna, costs ₹23,000 crore annually. The appeal drew sharp criticism from opposition leaders and anxiety from middle-class consumers regarding potential subsidy rollbacks.
articles.description: Tejashwi Yadav has been continuously criticising the Samrat Choudhary-led National Democratic Alliance (NDA) government, claiming it to be “on the verge of bankruptcy”

articles.headline: Student protests resume in France as pupils return to school
articles.title: Student protests resume in France as pupils return to school
articles.description: Student protests resume in France as pupils return to school

articles.headline: Pakistan warns Afghanistan that cross-border terrorism remains a red line.
articles.title: Terrorism is 'red line': Pakistan tells Afghanistan as it warns of action against cross-border threats
articles.summary: Pakistan stated on October 31, 2026, that it reserves the right to take necessary measures against cross-border security threats originating from Afghanistan. The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting accused the Afghan Taliban administration of inaction regarding militancy. The statement followed remarks from Afghan spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid, who argued that Islamabad lacked readiness for dialogue and shifted blame rather than resolving bilateral tensions.
articles.description: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting of Pakistan, on Saturday, accused the Afghan Taliban leadership of refusing to address militancy emanating from Afghan soil and instead shifting blame on Islamabad for the deterioration in bilateral ties

articles.headline: ‘Work to do’: Authorities give update on Florida private jet crash
articles.title: ‘Work to do’: Authorities give update on Florida private jet crash
articles.description: Officials have provided an update on the investigation into Sunday’s deadly Learjet crash in Florida.

articles.headline: Maharashtra forms drought panel and approves flood relief funds for farmers
articles.title: Maharashtra sets up drought mitigation panel, approves ₹291.91 crore relief for flood-hit farmers
articles.summary: The Maharashtra government announced a high-level committee on November 1, 2026, to oversee soil and water conservation projects in drought-hit regions. Simultaneously, authorities approved ₹291.91 crore in financial assistance for farmers affected by heavy rainfall and flooding between June and August 2026. The relief covers crop damage across six revenue divisions and agricultural land restoration, with payments transferred directly to bank accounts.
articles.description: The measures follow deficient rainfall in parts of Maharashtra during 2026, prompting the government to declare drought in talukas identified under the Kharif season’s Trigger-1 assessment

articles.headline: Progressive allies of New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani contest congressional seats
articles.title: Mamdani’s progressive allies vie for seats in Congress
articles.summary: Following primary victories in June, progressive congressional candidates Claire Valdez, Brad Lander, and Darializa Avila Chevalier are competing in Tuesday's midterm elections with platforms focused on abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement, ending military aid to Israel, and establishing universal healthcare. Backed by New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, the candidates seek to translate bold campaign promises into tangible federal policies amidst shifting political dynamics.
articles.description: Three New York City progressive Democrats are expected to win their midterm congressional races in Tuesday's election.

articles.headline: US voters head to polls amid tight congressional races and economic concerns
articles.title: US midterms: 2 days to go – Who leads in the polls as Trump rallies
articles.summary: Democratic and Republican leaders made final campaign pushes ahead of United States midterm elections featuring crucial Senate races. Polling indicates Democrats lead nationally while addressing voter anxieties regarding cost of living and the ongoing conflict involving Iran. Meanwhile, over fifty one million Americans have already cast ballots through mail-in systems or early voting locations.
articles.description: Democrats remain ahead in national polls as Trump and candidates make their final push in the days before polling day.

articles.headline: United Nations terminates Western Sahara peacekeeping mission
articles.title: What’s the future of the Western Sahara conflict?
articles.summary: The United Nations has concluded its peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara after the United States and Russia blocked proposals to extend its mandate. This region has experienced one of Africa's longest territorial disputes since Spanish colonial rule ended over fifty years ago, with both Morocco and the Polisario Front claiming sovereignty over the contested area.
articles.description: The UN is ending its peacekeeping mission in the disputed territory after the US and Russia blocked its extension.

articles.headline: Mamdani-endorsed progressives fight to join Congress
articles.title: Mamdani-endorsed progressives fight to join Congress
articles.description: Zohran Mamdani is championing a slate of Congressional candidates who want to take progressive policies national.

articles.headline: Trump at Halloween party ‘as himself’ says he’s ‘in no hurry’ with Iran
articles.title: Trump at Halloween party ‘as himself’ says he’s ‘in no hurry’ with Iran
articles.description: Trump, who came to his Halloween party dressed as himself, says US not in a hurry to make a decision on striking Iran.

articles.headline: Eight labourers electrocuted during road construction work in Rajasthan
articles.title: Eight labourers electrocuted after machine touches power line
articles.summary: Eight labourers died from electrocution while working on a road construction project in Chhapoli village located within Rajasthan's Jhunjhunu district. According to local police, the tragedy occurred when a gravel-mixing machine came into direct contact with an overhead high-tension power line, causing lethal electrical currents to pass through the equipment and strike the workers at the site.
articles.description: Villagers said power lines were touching trees and claimed that no staff member was available at the Grid Sub-Station when they called to have the power supply disconnected

articles.headline: Iran security chief says US letter signals ‘positive’ shift
articles.title: Iran security chief says US letter signals ‘positive’ shift
articles.description: US Vice-President JD Vance has sent a letter to Iran’s security chief in a reported effort to revive talks.

articles.headline: South African court convicts man of farm theft
articles.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
articles.summary: A South African court convicted Imanuwela David and cleaner Froliana Joseph on Monday of theft and conspiracy regarding a 2020 burglary at President Cyril Ramaphosa's Phala Phala farm in Limpopo province. David was found guilty of stealing over five hundred thousand dollars in cash, which led to a major political scandal. Pre-sentencing is scheduled for November 13.
articles.description: The case, part of the "Farmgate" scandal, has left President Cyril Ramaphosa mired in an impeachment saga.

articles.headline: Madhya Pradesh Police inspector mowed down by truck carrying illicit liquor in Dewas
articles.title: M.P. Police inspector mowed down by truck carrying illicit liquor in Dewas; racket supplying liquor to Gujarat uncovered
articles.summary: A Madhya Pradesh Police inspector was killed in Dewas district after being struck by a truck intercepted for allegedly smuggling illegal liquor. According to the superintendent of police, the officer was leading a team on the Indore-Betul highway when the incident occurred. Police seized the vehicle containing over 1,800 litres of liquor without bills as an investigation and search for the fleeing staff continue.
articles.description: According to police, the liquor was being smuggled from Harda district to Gujarat; truck owner arrested, driver remains at large

articles.headline: What Florida jet audio and flight data tells us about its final moments
articles.title: What Florida jet audio and flight data tells us about its final moments
articles.description: A private jet crashed in Florida on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, according to US authorities.

articles.headline: President Trump says United States still has one or two targets in Iran
articles.title: President Trump says U.S. still has ‘one or two targets’ in Iran
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump stated on October 31, 2026, that much of Iran's military has been incapacitated, though one or two sites remain. Meanwhile, Iranian supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei warned of severe reprisals against American and Israeli assets. Mediators from Qatar are currently engaged in diplomatic efforts in Tehran to prevent further escalation of the ongoing conflict.
articles.description: The President said the United States is not in a hurry to take offensive action because it had already decimated Iran’s military and nuclear programme

articles.headline: Human Rights Watch demands Zambia stop political crackdown
articles.title: HRW calls on Zambia to halt post-election crackdown
articles.summary: Human Rights Watch released a report on Sunday urging Zambian authorities to immediately cease a severe crackdown on the political opposition, journalists, and lawyers following President Hakainde Hichilema's disputed August election victory. The rights organization accused security forces of arbitrary detentions, beatings, and forced disappearances, demanding an independent investigation into the abuses.
articles.description: Opposition figures arrested and disappeared since President Hakainde Hichilema claimed August victory.

articles.headline: Mass displacement and extensive destruction continue across Gaza, the West Bank and Lebanon.
articles.title: Israel’s war on homes: From Hebron to Gaza and southern Lebanon
articles.summary: Military operations and widespread demolitions have displaced thousands of residents and destroyed infrastructure across the occupied West Bank, Gaza, and southern Lebanon. According to United Nations agencies and international organizations, hundreds of thousands of people remain displaced amid ongoing conflict. Human rights officials warn that the widespread devastation and forced expulsions raise serious concerns regarding violations of international law.
articles.description: From Hebron to Gaza to southern Lebanon, Israel is tearing down homes, and, with them, families' hopes of return.

articles.headline: Gaza healthcare workers face severe trauma and bereavement during the war.
articles.title: Gaza doctors struggle with bereavement, overwork, trauma amid genocidal war
articles.summary: Medical personnel in Gaza experience profound psychological distress while working under extreme pressure during the ongoing conflict. According to official reports, numerous healthcare workers have been killed, detained, or suffered personal bereavement and displacement. Medical professionals struggle to balance humanitarian duties with untreated trauma amid severe staff shortages and a lack of adequate psychological support systems.
articles.description: Doctors and nurses struggle to cope with the horrors they endured during the height of the Gaza war.

articles.headline: United Kingdom softens immigration rules to allow certain migrant care workers permanent residency
articles.title: Many U.K. social care migrant workers to get PR in five years under softer immigration overhaul
articles.summary: Foreign social care workers who arrived in the United Kingdom before May 2025 will be eligible for permanent residency after five years under final rules announced by Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood. The policy adjustment responds to intense pressure from health unions and Labour Party members following previous draft proposals that required a fifteen-year wait. The revised framework also offers a second chance to workers affected by initial visa conditions while penalising exploitative employers.
articles.description: Under the scheme, finalised on November 2, social care workers earning at least £25,000 per year, who arrived in the U.K. before May 2025, would be eligible for ‘indefinite leave to remain’ (ILR) after five years

articles.headline: Palnadu district administration placed on high alert as Cyclone Murasu approaches coast
articles.title: Palnadu on high alert as Cyclone Murasu to bring heavy rain
articles.summary: Authorities in the Palnadu district have declared a high alert ahead of Cyclone Murasu, which is expected to bring heavy rainfall and severe weather to the region. Collector Kritika Shukla instructed local departments to secure vulnerable infrastructure, clear drainage obstructions, and prepare emergency response teams. Officials have also implemented special protective measures for upcoming municipal election vote counting centres to safeguard ballot papers against potential water damage.
articles.description: The cyclone's impact is expected to be significant in the district on November 2 and 3, and people have been advised to remain vigilant; Collector instructs all departments to remain prepared and take precautionary measures to minimise the impact of heavy rainfall

articles.headline: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla emphasizes importance of dissent and democracy in Panchkula
articles.title: Lok Sabha Speaker Birla calls dissent essential to democracy
articles.summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla stated that divergent viewpoints are natural within a democratic society during an address at the Janpratinidhi Sammelan in Panchkula. Speaking on November 2, 2026, Birla highlighted that respectful dissent provides essential direction and inspires collective progress. The event also featured remarks from Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini and opposition leader Bhupinder Singh Hooda, who addressed regional challenges concerning fiscal health, crime rates, and employment.
articles.description: Dissent must also be respected, he said at the inaugural session of the ‘Janpratinidhi Sammelan’ (Public Representatives’ Conference) organised under the ‘Samvidhan Pakhwada’ (Constitution Fortnight) by the Haryana Legislative Assembly in Panchkula

articles.headline: Indian opposition coalition plans massive Delhi rally demanding election chief resignation
articles.title: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
articles.summary: Tens of thousands of people are expected to gather at Ramlila Maidan in Delhi for a mega opposition rally demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Organised by the Congress party and supported by the Cockroach Janta Party, the protest follows a voter-list revision exercise that removed 130 million names from draft rolls across India.
articles.description: Thousands gathered in the heart of delhi, calling for the chief election commissioner to step down.

articles.headline: Senegal hosts historic Youth Olympic Games as Africa holds first Olympic event
articles.title: Senegal hosts Africa’s first Olympics
articles.summary: Senegal has welcomed more than two thousand athletes for the Youth Olympic Games, marking the historic first time Africa has hosted an Olympic event. International Olympic Committee head Kirsty Coventry praised the milestone for the continent, although President Bassirou Diomaye Faye acknowledges domestic economic concerns regarding the event's cost. Originally postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the games serve as a critical test for Africa's ability to organise major international sports competitions.
articles.description: The head of the International Olympic Committee discusses the significance of Africa hosting the Youth Olympic Games.

articles.headline: US judge dismisses Donald Trump defamation lawsuit against Wall Street Journal
articles.title: ‘Epstein Files’: U.S. Judge dismisses Trump lawsuit against Wall Street Journal
articles.summary: A United States judge dismissed President Donald Trump's ten billion dollar defamation lawsuit against the Wall Street Journal on October thirty first. The court ruled that Mr Trump failed to establish actual malice regarding a published twenty twenty five report about his alleged two thousand three letter to Jeffrey Epstein. Meanwhile, the administration faced separate legal challenges over a proposed capital arch.
articles.description: Donald Trump had sued for $10 billion after the newspaper’s story was published in July 2025 detailing the President’s alleged 2003 letter to Epstein, which apparently featured a drawing of a naked woman

articles.headline: German metal union launches strikes over wages and job security
articles.title: German unions launch wave of strikes over cost-of-living pressures
articles.summary: Industrial action involving the IG Metall union escalated on Monday, impacting major manufacturing firms such as Audi, Mercedes-Benz and Tata Steel. The union demands a five percent wage rise and stronger job protections to counter inflation. Employers offered lower increases starting in 2027, which were rejected. The ongoing protests reflect broader economic dissatisfaction seen across multiple European nations.
articles.description: The expanded industrial action comes amid a wave of strikes and protests that have sparked unrest across Europe.

articles.headline: Infant deaths in Attappady renew concerns over tribal health and socioeconomic conditions
articles.title: How infant deaths in Keralam’s Attappady expose a deep-rooted health, social crisis
articles.summary: The recent deaths of 12 infants in Attappady have highlighted a persistent child health crisis affecting tribal communities in Keralam. Figures from tribal activists indicate that 124 infants have died in the region since 2011 alongside numerous abortions and stillbirths. While the State government has initiated an expert assessment, tribal organizations stress that solutions require addressing broader nutritional, maternal health, landlessness, and socioeconomic challenges.
articles.description: 12 infants, including 10 tribals, have died in Attappady this year, sparking a political row as the State government orders an expert probe. Tribal activists say the crisis demands action beyond healthcare, addressing malnutrition, anaemia and deep-rooted social issues

articles.headline: Saint-Gobain India and IIT-Madras establish sustainable construction research laboratories
articles.title: Saint-Gobain, IIT-Madras to set up modern research labs
articles.summary: Saint-Gobain India and the Indian Institute of Technology Madras announced a collaboration on November 3, 2026, backed by a ₹3.8 crore grant over three years. The partnership will establish two research laboratories focusing on digital sensing technologies and concrete admixtures to address productivity, material efficiency, and sustainability challenges in the construction sector.

articles.headline: Hacked Ukrainian air raid app triggers false nuclear and chemical alerts
articles.title: Fake nuclear warning from hacked app sparks unease but not panic in Ukraine
articles.summary: A compromised air raid alert application in Ukraine generated false warnings on November 2, 2026, falsely predicting nuclear strikes and street combat. Ukrainian officials confirmed the system was hacked, clarifying there was no radiation threat. Cybersecurity experts warned that the incident highlighted vulnerabilities in national emergency notification systems used by millions of citizens.
articles.description: Many Ukrainians, who have faced years of Russian attacks, did not take the messages seriously and doubted their veracity.

articles.headline: US petrol prices dip amid diplomatic efforts to end war on Iran
articles.title: US petrol prices dip ahead of midterms as voters eye costs
articles.summary: Average US petrol prices declined to $4.17 per gallon on Monday, falling from previous weeks according to the American Automobile Association. The decrease coincides with falling oil prices and ongoing diplomatic efforts in Qatar to end the conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. Cost-of-living pressures remain a central concern for voters ahead of upcoming midterm elections.
articles.description: Diesel prices ease to $6.29 per gallon, offering slight relief amid a global fuel demand squeeze.

articles.headline: Social media users in India report blocked posts amid protests
articles.title: ‘Unavailable in India’: Why are social media posts being blocked amid protests? | Explained
articles.summary: Social media users in India have reported widespread blocking of posts, reels, and accounts across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, and X. According to reports, automated restrictions were implemented under the Information Technology Rules of 2021. This development comes amid nationwide protests against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and demands for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
articles.description: MeitY’s advisory to Meta, shorter takedown deadlines under amended IT Rules, and platforms’ own enforcement policies have brought renewed scrutiny of how online content is blocked, and what recourse users have

articles.headline: Supermarket freezer cyber-attacks highlight broader vulnerabilities in internet-connected smart devices
articles.title: If hackers can take control of a supermarket freezer, how vulnerable is other tech?
articles.summary: Suspected cyber-attacks targeting supermarket refrigerators and freezers across Europe have raised concerns about the security of internet-connected smart devices and industrial hardware. Ciaran Martin, former chief executive of the United Kingdom's National Cyber Security Centre, stated that manufacturers must build safer devices. Researchers from UK Cyber Defence identified over eight hundred refrigeration interfaces associated with British retailers accessible over the internet.
articles.description: Dozens of shops across European countries have been hit by a cyber-attack affecting their fridges.

articles.headline: Opposition alliance conducts symbolic public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
articles.title: INDIA bloc holds symbolic ‘public impeachment’ of CEC Gyanesh Kumar on six charges
articles.summary: Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance leaders unanimously adopted a motion during a parliamentary simulation at Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence. Opposition figures accused the election official of manipulating rolls and conspiring with ruling leaders. Senior politicians warned that administrative staff implementing alleged electoral irregularities would face future accountability.
articles.description: Move reflects the closure of institutional avenues, says LoP Rahul Gandhi; terms it a political weapon against all who colluded to destroy votes; warns ECI officials that they are first target; says CEC should be tried for treason

articles.headline: Federal judge dismisses criminal case against two former FBI officials
articles.title: Judge dismisses charges against FBI agents involved in Hunter Biden case
articles.summary: US Magistrate Judge Zia Faruqui dismissed a criminal case on Monday against former Federal Bureau of Investigation officials Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides. The judge ruled that prosecutors from the Department of Justice lacked sufficient evidence, expressing concern that the investigation was rushed and political. The defendants had been accused of misleading Congress in 2023 regarding Hunter Biden.
articles.description: A federal judge tossed charges accusing two former FBI officials of lying to Congress about Hunter Biden investigation.

articles.headline: INDIA bloc supporters gather at Ramlila Maidan for Chalo Dilli protest
articles.title: INDIA bloc’s ‘Chalo Dilli’ protest: Supporters gather at Ramlila Maidan, across capital
articles.summary: Opposition alliance supporters began gathering at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan for the Chalo Dilli protest on November first to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The demonstration follows allegations of widespread voter roll manipulation. Authorities deployed over four thousand police personnel across the capital while organisers prepared barricades and stages for the anticipated crowds.
articles.description: Many supporters arrived in Delhi, while several others had reached the national capital on October 31, 2026 or earlier as parties mobilised their cadres from different states for the protest

articles.headline: OpenAI announces new data center program to free power during emergencies
articles.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
articles.summary: OpenAI announced on Monday that it will pilot its Grid Protectors Program at a planned data center in Effingham County, Georgia. The company stated the initiative will free up to 1,000 megawatts of electricity during extreme weather to support local homes. The strategy aims to address growing public and legislative backlash across the United States regarding the immense energy demands of artificial intelligence infrastructure.
articles.description: In an announcement on Monday, OpenAI says it will pilot its "Grid Protectors Program" at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, where the company promises to free up to 1,000 megawatts of power during extreme weather or emergencies, enough to power air conditioners in around 700,000 homes. The announcement comes as opposition to […]

articles.headline: Manisha Bhanwala wins India’s first women’s wrestling world title in Astana
articles.title: Manisha Bhanwala: The 29-year-old who ended India’s wait for a women’s wrestling world title
articles.summary: Wrestler Manisha Bhanwala secured a historic gold medal in the 59kg freestyle category at the World Wrestling Championships in Astana, Kazakhstan, defeating American competitor Abigail Nette on October 31, 2026. This victory marks India's first-ever women's world title in the sport. The 29-year-old athlete from Jind, Haryana, dedicated her triumph to her late father Suresh Bhanwala, capping an unprecedented campaign that also featured silver medals from teammates Neelam Sirohi and Kajal Dhochak.
articles.description: From a village in Haryana to the pinnacle of international wrestling, Manisha Bhanwala scripted history in Kazakhstan, becoming India’s first woman world champion

articles.headline: Supermarket freezers across seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
articles.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
articles.summary: Dozens of supermarkets across seven European countries suffered refrigerator and freezer malfunctions caused by a suspected cyber-attack that forced evaporator settings into defrost mode. Stores in Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden, Ireland, the Netherlands, Estonia, and Finland reported spoiled produce and rising temperatures. Sabcobel CEO Stephan Moelans stated that affected units were disconnected from networks while national cybersecurity agencies monitored the ongoing situation.
articles.description: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

articles.headline: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
articles.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
articles.description: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.

articles.headline: Arab citizens surge to polls in high-turnout Israeli election
articles.title: Ra’am and Joint List | The surge of the other
articles.summary: Israel recorded a high voter turnout of seventy-seven percent during its recent general election, driven by an overwhelming mobilization among Arab citizens. The Joint List and the United Arab List secured a combined nineteen seats in parliament. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu criticized the surge, while Arab leaders sought representation against policies they argue perpetuate discrimination.
articles.description: Israel’s Arab parties made historic gains in elections but uncertainty remains whether the opposition bloc would join hands with them to form a government

articles.headline: Scientists use epigenetic control to silence hepatitis B viral DNA
articles.title: Gene therapy offers to beat hepatitis B virus by muting its DNA
articles.summary: Researchers have developed an experimental therapy called CRMA-1001 that successfully silences hepatitis B virus DNA in mice by selectively adding methylation marks without altering host genes. According to a study published on September 21 in Nature Biomedical Engineering, the technique utilizes CRISPR-Cas9 to deliver the silencing machinery, offering a promising path toward a lasting functional cure by preventing viral rebound.
articles.description: An experimental therapy called CRMA-1001 is a remarkable development because, instead of targeting the virus directly, it silences the viral DNA; this is promising because current treatments rarely eliminate the DNA, which allows the virus to rebound

articles.headline: Three Aam Aadmi Party MLAs join Bharatiya Janata Party in Punjab
articles.title: Three AAP leaders join BJP ahead of Punjab Assembly election
articles.summary: Three Aam Aadmi Party legislators, including Kunwar Vijay Pratap Singh, Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra and Chetan Singh Jauramajra, joined the Bharatiya Janata Party at headquarters in New Delhi on November 2, 2026. Two of the quitting politicians cited unfulfilled promises from the 2022 polls. The ruling Aam Aadmi Party criticised the Bharatiya Janata Party for inducting leaders facing serious allegations.
articles.description: Amritsar North MLA Kunwar Vijay Pratap, Sanour MLA Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra and Samana MLA Chetan Singh Jauramajra join the BJP in Delhi; State BJP president Kewal Singh Dhillon says it indicates the impending end of the party’s regime in Punjab

articles.headline: Dutch authorities offer record reward for fugitive drug lord Jos Leijdekkers
articles.title: Dutch police offer record €2m reward in hunt for drug lord
articles.summary: Dutch authorities announced a record reward of two million euros on Monday for information leading to the arrest of Jos Leijdekkers. Justice Minister David van Weel emphasized the threat posed by the fugitive, who was previously convicted in absentia in Rotterdam and Belgium for drug smuggling and money laundering. Europol lists Leijdekkers among Europe's most-wanted suspects.
articles.description: Jos Leijdekkers has been found guilty in absentia of cocaine smuggling and is believed to be in Sierra Leone.

articles.headline: Drone strikes target multiple electricity substations across eastern and northern Sudan
articles.title: Drone attacks extend campaign targeting Sudan’s power system
articles.summary: Drone strikes hit three electricity substations in New Halfa, Aroma, and Northern State on Monday, causing widespread power outages. Local media reports indicate this brings the total number of attacks on Sudan's electricity network to 18 within a week. Sudan's military government accused Ethiopia of assisting the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces in targeting civilian infrastructure.
articles.description: Attacks the latest to disrupt electricity supplies; army reports new defections from paramilitary RSF.

articles.headline: Village defence guard and wife found dead from bullet wounds in Reasi
articles.title: Village guard, wife die of bullet wounds in Jammu’s Reasi
articles.summary: Javed Ahmed, a village defence guard, and his wife Shaheen Akhter were found dead from bullet wounds in Jammu and Kashmir's Reasi district on November 2, 2026. Initial reports suggested the shots were fired from a government-issued service weapon. Separately, an Army porter was injured by an anti-personnel mine near the Line of Control in Rajouri district.
articles.description: This is the third such incident in the past two years in the Jammu region

articles.headline: India thrashes Korea to finish league phase of Asian Champions Trophy
articles.title: Asian Champions Trophy: India ends league phase with a thumping win over Korea
articles.summary: The Indian men's hockey team defeated Korea 8-0 on November 2, 2026, finishing the league stage of the Asian Champions Trophy with complete domination and an undefeated run. Dilpreet Singh scored twice in the match held ahead of the upcoming semifinals. In another fixture, Japan defeated Malaysia 2-1 to secure second place in the tournament standings.
articles.description: The two teams will meet again in Wednesday’s semifinal while Japan takes on Malaysia in the other last-four clash

articles.headline: Foreign secretary Vikram Misri to visit Nepal for bilateral talks
articles.title: In first high-level visit after new government’s arrival, Foreign Secretary Misri to visit Nepal on November 4-5
articles.summary: Ministry of External Affairs announced that Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri will visit Kathmandu on November 4 and 5, 2026. The high-level visit follows Prime Minister Balendra Shah taking charge in March. Discussions will cover bilateral cooperation and former Indian Army soldiers protested in Kathmandu demanding resumed Gurkha recruitment under the Agnipath scheme.
articles.description: Misri’s visit to include discussions on Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s visit to India; appointment of Nepal’s new Ambassador to India and disaster assistance following the flash floods are also expected to be on the agenda

articles.headline: Congress demands Joint Parliamentary Committee probe into IDBI Bank sale
articles.title: Congress seeks JPC probe into IDBI Bank sale, alleges valuation irregularities
articles.summary: The Congress party demanded an immediate halt and a Joint Parliamentary Committee investigation into the proposed sale of IDBI Bank to Canada-based Fairfax Financial Holdings. Senior leader Shaktisinh Gohil alleged valuation manipulations and transparency issues in the government's October 14 approval to divest a majority stake for approximately 53,000 crore rupees.
articles.description: The party questions the use of bank’s funds by Fairfax to finance acquisition; demands disclosure of valuation reports

articles.headline: Enterprise analytics report highlights poor quality and context issues in AI agents
articles.title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
articles.summary: A sponsored report by MIT Technology Review's Insights and Snowflake reveals that fewer than half of agent-generated insights lead to business improvement due to insufficient context and fragmented data. While generative AI expands analytics access, 52 percent of surveyed organizations face insight overload, prompting companies to prioritize data governance and semantic layers to improve performance.
articles.description: In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automating entire workflows and taking actions based on agent insights. But there is a problem: The quality of insights that agents currently generate…

articles.headline: H.D. Kumaraswamy dares Bengaluru police to take action against him
articles.title: Nobody has the guts, says HDK, dares police to take action against him
articles.summary: Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy challenged the Bengaluru City Police to arrest him on November 2, 2026, while denying allegations that a controversial sting video targeting former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah was exchanged at his Delhi home. Accusing Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar of conspiring with the accused, Kumaraswamy questioned the objectivity of the ongoing Central Crime Branch investigation.
articles.description: Kumaraswamy accuses Shivakumar of conspiring to distribute ‘sleaze’ videos of Prajwal Revanna; he accuses the Bengaluru Police Commissioner of acting at the behest of the Chief Minister and questions the objectivity of the probe in the sting video case

articles.headline: Karnataka invites Japanese businesses to build technology and manufacturing partnerships
articles.title: Bring your technology; we’ll provide talent, land and partnerships, Karnataka tells Japanese business delegation
articles.summary: The Karnataka government urged Japanese enterprises to leverage the State's industrial ecosystem, skilled talent pool, and supportive policies during the India-Japan Business Summit 2026. Principal Secretary S. Selvakumar emphasized local strengths in electronics and aerospace manufacturing on November 2, 2026, while trade bodies signed agreements to train engineering students in Japanese language skills.

articles.headline: Jerusalem Daily: Israel’s lockdown of Hebron comes to an end
articles.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israel’s lockdown of Hebron comes to an end
articles.description: Israeli forces ended their lockdown of Hebron in the occupied West Bank, but its forces continued to attack a school.

articles.headline: Congress reviews election preparedness for Uttarakhand and Manipur assemblies
articles.title: Congress reviews poll preparedness in Uttarakhand, Manipur; targets BJP governments
articles.summary: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge led high-level meetings on November 2, 2026, with party leaders from Uttarakhand and Manipur to evaluate organizational readiness for upcoming assembly polls. Attendees discussed electoral strategies alongside criticisms of Bharatiya Janata Party governance, citing prolonged ethnic conflict in Manipur and deteriorating law enforcement in Uttarakhand.
articles.description: After meeting Congress leaders from Uttarakhand, party chief Mallikarjun Kharge accuses the BJP’s ‘double engine’ government of betraying the hopes and aspirations of the people over its 10 years in power in the State

articles.headline: Parliament panel to discuss helicopter safety following Uttarakhand crash
articles.title: Parliament panel to meet on Uttarakhand helicopter crash
articles.summary: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Transport, Tourism and Culture scheduled a meeting for November 13 with aviation officials to review helicopter safety. The panel, led by Janata Dal-United Member of Parliament Sanjay Jha, aims to examine frequent crashes in Uttarakhand, including a recent incident on October 30 that resulted in six fatalities near Joshimath.
articles.description: The panel is also expected to deliberate on the high number of helicopter crashes that were reported from Uttarakhand in 2025

articles.headline: U.K. Defence Minister warns EU against protectionist policies in Brussels
articles.title: U.K. warns EU against keeping Britain out of ‘Made in Europe’
articles.summary: United Kingdom Defence Minister Wes Streeting cautioned the European Union on November 2 against potential protectionism in its industrial strategy. Speaking ahead of a Brussels summit scheduled for November 20 with Prime Minister Andy Burnham and European officials, Streeting expressed concern that British industries might face exclusion from the Made in Europe initiative.
articles.description: The European Union wants to boost domestic sectors like cars and defence by forcing companies to buy European if they want public money

articles.headline: Karnataka Rakshana Vedike begins state-wide campaign to collect IT employment data
articles.title: Despite CM’s appeal, KRV begins State-wide drive to seek hiring data from IT firms
articles.summary: The Karnataka Rakshana Vedike launched a month-long state-wide campaign to request recruitment details from information technology and biotechnology companies regarding local hiring practices. Led by state president T.A. Narayanagowda, members visited nearly fifty companies on November 2, 2026, despite an appeal from Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar to avoid direct visits while the government examines discrimination allegations.

articles.headline: India will maintain capital expenditure to support economic growth, Sitharaman says
articles.title: Capex push to continue, but fiscal prudence non-negotiable: FM
articles.summary: Union Finance and Corporate Affairs Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated on Monday in Mumbai that the Indian government will sustain its capital expenditure push to secure economic growth. Speaking at an HSBC India event, she emphasized that fiscal prudence remains a top priority and that public investment multipliers have proven successful over the past four to five years.
articles.description: “India must to talk with optimism and there needs to be reduction in cynicism says Ms. Sitaraman

articles.headline: Japan urges US military discipline following second Marine arrest in Okinawa
articles.title: Japan urges U.S. to enforce discipline after second Marine arrest
articles.summary: Japanese Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi announced on Monday that Tokyo has requested the United States strictly enforce troop discipline. The appeal follows the recent arrest of a Marine on suspicion of drunk driving during a curfew, coming shortly after another serviceman was indicted for murder in Okinawa.
articles.description: The case has triggered outrage in Japan and reignited controversy over the heavy U.S. military presence on the southern island

articles.headline: At least seven migrants die on boat bound for Canary Islands amid storm
articles.title: At least seven migrants die on boat bound for Canary Islands amid storm
articles.description: At least seven migrants have died aboard a boat carrying 139 people bound for the Canary Islands after a storm hit.

articles.headline: Birla Estates targets residential expansion and tenfold commercial rental growth
articles.title: Birla Estates eyes top-three spot, targets 10-fold jump in office rentals
articles.summary: Real estate developer Birla Estates plans to expand its residential portfolio across major cities while aiming for a tenfold increase in annual commercial rental income to fifteen hundred crore rupees over four to five years. Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer K.T. Jithendran stated that residential demand remains strong, particularly in Bengaluru where market growth outperformed other urban regions.
articles.description: There is no sign of slowness in the market as both pricing and absorption remain extremely steady and positive, says K.T. Jithendran, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, Birla Estates

articles.headline: Kimi Antonelli becomes Formula One's youngest champion in Mexico City
articles.title: Antonelli’s coronation could well be the change of guard
articles.summary: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli secured his maiden Formula One driver championship after finishing third in the Mexico Grand Prix on Sunday. The twenty-year-old Italian became the sport's youngest titleholder by surpassing Sebastian Vettel. Team boss Toto Wolff gambled on the rookie to replace Lewis Hamilton, and Antonelli capitalized with a five-race winning streak and a historic victory in Monza.
articles.description: It was fitting that he was joined on the rostrum by Verstappen (winner) and Hamilton (second), the two drivers who have been the icons of Formula One for the last 15 years

articles.headline: Maine lobster industry faces economic strain from tariffs and trade tensions
articles.title: Lobster industry caught in Maine’s political headwinds before US midterms
articles.summary: Commercial fishermen in Maine are grappling with rising operational costs and trade uncertainties ahead of the United States midterm elections. President Donald Trump's tariffs on Canadian goods and subsequent retaliatory measures have disrupted supply chains where a significant portion of the catch is processed across the border.
articles.description: Senator Susan Collins and Democratic challenger Troy Jackson clash over tariffs and their impact on Maine's economy.

articles.headline: Hebron residents return home after Israeli military operation concludes
articles.title: Displaced in Hebron: Picking up pieces after Israeli siege
articles.summary: Palestinian families in the occupied West Bank city of Hebron began returning to their homes on Monday following a 10-day Israeli military operation. According to the Hebron Governorate’s Support and Relief Committee, approximately 3,300 people from 537 families were displaced during the security restrictions that affected several local neighborhoods.
articles.description: Displaced Hebron families return to damaged homes, left to pick up scattered pieces of their lives after Israeli siege.

articles.headline: Bharatiya Janata Party announces state-wide youth outreach campaign starting November 9
articles.title: BJP plans ‘Save Democracy, Eradicate Anarchy’ campaign starting Nov. 9
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party MLA V. Sunil Kumar announced a youth outreach campaign titled Prajaprabhutva ulisi, aarajakathe alisi, running across 500 locations from November 9 to 30. During a press conference, Mr. Kumar criticized the Congress government over electoral roll revisions, delayed milk subsidies, and drought relief conditions, while demanding a transparent investigation into a recent sting operation.
articles.description: BJP MLA Sunil Kumar accuses the Congress of misleading people by selectively questioning the credibility of EVMs, raising objections to SIR

articles.headline: Karnataka High Court declares cross-border police operation by Maharashtra personnel illegal
articles.title: Deepfakes, impersonation of probe agencies call for verified inter-State police operations, says Karnataka HC
articles.summary: The High Court of Karnataka ruled that an investigative operation conducted by Maharashtra police at tobacco firms in Tumakuru was illegal for failing to coordinate with local authorities. Justice Suraj Govindaraj emphasized that rising cyber fraud and deepfakes necessitate strict verification during inter-state police operations to prevent intimidation by potential imposters. While declaring the local inspection invalid, the court declined to quash the underlying criminal case.
articles.description: Finds Maharashtra police action in Karnataka without informing local police illegal

articles.headline: Prakasam district administration prepares precautions as Cyclone Murasu approaches
articles.title: Prakasam district on high alert as Murasu cyclone approaches
articles.summary: Prakasam district authorities accelerated preparations for Cyclone Murasu on November 2, 2026, identifying twenty-six vulnerable villages and establishing seventy relief centres. Special officer Ranjit Basha and Collector P. Rajababu directed officials to evacuate vulnerable residents, deploy disaster response teams, and arrange emergency supplies to minimize potential damage from strong winds.

articles.headline: Telangana Congress mobilises thousands of party workers for Delhi public meeting
articles.title: Telangana Congress showcases its might in Delhi rally with massive participation
articles.summary: The Telangana Congress mobilised over fifteen thousand leaders and supporters for an opposition public meeting in New Delhi on November 2, 2026. Despite railway authorities declining special train permissions, Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy and Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee president B. Mahesh Kumar Goud arranged alternative transport using over one hundred buses and private vehicles to demonstrate the party organizational strength.
articles.description: CM Revanth and PCC president Mahesh Goud made it possible with minute preparations

articles.headline: Foreign secretary Vikram Misri attributes Chinese harshness to pandemic stigma
articles.title: Global criticism during COVID-19 hardened China’s attitude towards world: Foreign Secretary Misri
articles.summary: India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri stated on October 31, 2026, that global criticism and a sense of stigmatization during the COVID-19 pandemic caused China to adopt a harsh attitude toward the international community and enforce strict internal lockdowns. Speaking at the Iqwat Global Business Conclave, Misri reflected on his tenure as ambassador to China, recalling the immense challenges posed by bilateral stress, travel restrictions, and the 2020 Galwan Valley confrontation.
articles.description: Misri also recalled that he faced a major challenge during his posting in China as Ambassador, when India and China had an unprecedented confrontation in eastern Ladakh's Galwan Valley

articles.headline: Raptadu school chainsaw attack victim recovers as political leaders demand compensation
articles.title: Raptadu chainsaw attack victim shows signs of recovery; Jagan seeks ₹50 lakh compensation
articles.summary: Gopika, a Class X student injured in a chainsaw attack at a Zilla Parishad High School in Raptadu, is showing steady recovery at Manipal Hospital in Bengaluru. Human Resources Development and Information Technology Minister Nara Lokesh praised a classmate for intervening, while YSR Congress Party president Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy demanded 50 lakh rupees in compensation for the victim's family.
articles.description: Doctors at Manipal Hospital in Bengaluru say the Class X girl is conscious and improving; Minister Nara Lokesh praises her friend Lakshmi for her bravery and the YSRCP chief demands accountability from the State government

articles.headline: What we know about latest efforts to end US war on Iran
articles.title: What we know about latest efforts to end US war on Iran
articles.description: The foreign ministers of the US and Iran say a diplomatic end to the war is still possible.

articles.headline: Serbian railway station canopy collapse ends ruling party rule
articles.title: Student List | The young Serb unrest
articles.summary: The collapse of a concrete canopy at the Novi Sad Railway station in Serbia killed sixteen people, including two young children. Widespread public outrage over allegations of corruption and government negligence in the recently reconstructed state-funded project ultimately brought an end to fourteen years of rule by the Serbian Progressive Party led by Aleksandar Vucic.
articles.description: Serbia’s student protesters, who built a blockade movement against corruption and political establishment, brought down the government of Aleksandar Vučić

articles.headline: Directorate General of Civil Aviation probes Belagavi trainer aircraft crash
articles.title: Directorate General of Civil Aviation probe into Belagavi trainer aircraft crash finds many deficiencies in training academy
articles.summary: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation released a report stating that Redbird Flight Training Academy suffered from maintenance and manpower deficiencies during a 2023 crash. A student pilot executing a solo flight near Belagavi Airport experienced engine failure and forced a landing after using unauthorized fuel. The aircraft sustained heavy damage, though the pilot remained uninjured.
articles.description: On May 30, 2023, a 24-year-old student trainee pilot flying a TECNAM P2008JC aircraft was involved in a forced landing incident near Belagavi Airport while conducting a solo circuit and landing exercise.

articles.headline: Natural rubber price reaches a historic milestone of 300 rupees
articles.title: Rubber price touches record ₹300 a kg
articles.summary: Domestic natural rubber prices touched three hundred rupees per kilogram for the first time on Monday according to Rubber Board data. Officials attributed the rally to tight domestic supplies driven by El Nino and international energy pressures. The Union Commerce Ministry announced plans to include Keralam in upcoming plantation programs to boost regional production.
articles.description: Sharp rise in rubber prices is attributed to a combination of factors, including tight domestic supplies, low rubber production across Southeast Asian countries due to climatic factors, conflict in West Asia affecting synthetic rubber production. Centre plans to include Keralam in the second phase of ATMA’s plantation programme to boost local output.

articles.headline: Chief Minister announces new women's policy implementation without compromises
articles.title: Women’s policy will be implemented without compromises: CM
articles.summary: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan announced that a model women policy ensuring socio-economic development and safety will be implemented without compromises. Speaking at Her Summit 2026, he outlined plans for a special law against cyberattacks and initiatives for financial independence. Minister Bindhu Krishna added that the framework will focus on gender equality and entrepreneurship support.
articles.description: Says government mulling special Act to prevent cyber attacks on women; inaugurates Her Summit 2026 organised by Women and Child Development department for framing new women’s policy

articles.headline: Lula da Silva wins historic Brazilian presidential runoff election
articles.title: Lula da Silva | The Pele of Brazil’s politics
articles.summary: Lula da Silva made history by becoming the first Brazilian president to finish second in the initial election round and subsequently win the presidential runoff. During the campaign, opponent Flavio Bolsonaro weaponized an old injury involving da Silva losing a finger while working in a factory, prompting a sharp response from the Workers Party leader.
articles.description: The left-wing leader’s victory in Brazil, after finishing second in the first round, reflects the deep roots of the Workers’ Party, which built its support base through resistance to the military dictatorship in the early 1980s, as well as the declining appeal of Bolsonarismo

articles.headline: Israeli Arab parties set to back Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc
articles.title: Arab parties back Eisenkot: What’s the latest in Israel’s coalition talks?
articles.summary: Israel Arab parties winning nineteen seats are set to back opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, complicating Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu efforts to form a government. The Jewish opposition bloc fell short of a majority, while Arab factions like Raam and the Joint List offered outside support to oust Netanyahu despite facing political friction and ongoing election investigations.
articles.description: Political wrangling is still ongoing as all blocs weigh potential paths to power.

articles.headline: Three BSF personnel and civilian injured in Tripura border clash

articles.headline: U.S. President Donald Trump delays decision on fresh Iran strikes
articles.title: Rubio says U.S. yet to decide on new Iran strikes
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump has not yet decided on launching new military strikes against Iran amid stalled peace talks, according to Secretary of State Marco Rubio. articles.description: Iran’s supreme leader October 31, 2026 warned the United States and Israel against launching new attacks, following threats to resume strikes after crucial elections

articles.headline: Centre notifies grievance redressal rules for VB-G RAM G scheme

articles.summary: The Indian Ministry of Rural Development notified new grievance redressal rules for the Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission on November 2, 2026, mandating a 15-day resolution window for complaints. articles.headline: Karnataka Examination Authority introduces single examination system for 5,431 departmental posts
articles.title: Karnataka Examination Authority to conduct single examination for recruitment to multiple posts

Prasanna, the new system allows candidates to apply for multiple posts using one application and fee, reducing delays and financial burdens. articles.description: Recruitment through a CET-style counselling process; KEA will conduct a common examination for equivalent posts across 33 departments at once

articles.headline: Disadvantaged mother carries sick daughter across flooded terrain in S. Kota
articles.title: Tribal hamlet cut off from mainland forces woman carry sick daughter for treatment
articles.summary: A 36-year-old tribal woman named Sunkaramma carried her 11-year-old sick daughter Sampoorna for seven kilometres across hilly terrain in S. Kota due to a lack of transport after Cyclone Arnab damaged road connectivity. District Collector S. Ramsundar Reddy instructed officials to investigate the incident and ensure motorable road repairs following treatment at the S. Kota government hospital.

articles.headline: National Conference leadership negotiates with disgruntled legislators demanding internal reforms
articles.title: Top NC leaders reach out to disgruntled lawmakers in Jammu and Kashmir
articles.summary: The ruling National Conference in Jammu and Kashmir dispatched senior leaders, including Ali Muhammad Sagar, to meet roughly 20 dissident legislators following a meeting at lawmaker Qaiser Jamsheed Lone's residence on October 27. articles.headline: Texas Muslims focus on local stakes amid rising midterm election Islamophobia
articles.title: As Islamophobia ramps up in US midterms, Texas Muslims eye local stakes
articles.summary: Muslim voters in Texas face escalating Islamophobia during the final stretch of the midterm elections as state Republican leaders target Islamic customs and push policies against Sharia law. articles.description: Texas Muslims grapple with a slate of policies they say stigmatise their community, push for change at the ballot box.

articles.headline: Supreme Court dismisses government challenge against Vedanta arbitration awards
articles.title: Supreme Court raps Centre for stalling enforcement of Vedanta arbitration awards
articles.summary: The Supreme Court dismissed the Union government challenge against a Delhi High Court order that allowed mining major Vedanta Ltd. and Ravva Oil Singapore Pte. Ltd. to enforce foreign arbitration awards totaling nearly $99 million. A Bench questioned the resistance from the Centre, warning that prolonged legal delays could undermine India status as an international arbitration hub. articles.headline: Wizz Air flight escorted by Hungarian fighter jet after bomb threat
articles.title: Wizz Air flight from Luton in emergency landing after bomb threat
articles.summary: A Wizz Air flight travelling from London Luton Airport to Sofia was escorted by a Hungarian military fighter jet to Budapest following a mid-air bomb threat. Wizz Air confirmed that nothing suspicious was found during the checks and the aircraft prepared to resume its journey.
articles.description: A Hungarian fighter jet escorted the aircraft to Budapest after the threat was received mid-air.

articles.headline: Ukraine air raid app hacked to display false radiation and attack threats
articles.title: Fake nuclear warnings issued after Ukrainian and Russian air alert apps hacked
articles.summary: Ukraine’s Air Alert application was compromised on Sunday, sending false notifications of radiation, chemical, and street fighting threats in Kyiv. articles.headline: Eight-year-old boy suspended and evaluated after assaulting six-year-old girl

The victim received critical injuries and is recovering at PGIMER hospital in Chandigarh. Police registered a case against the school management for negligence, while the boy was placed in a juvenile observation home for psychiatric evaluation.
articles.description: The girl, who was seriously injured, is out of danger, but remains traumatised by her assault, her family said.

articles.headline: FBI links North Korea to record crypto heist

articles.summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation has attributed the theft of six point three billion dollars in virtual assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance to North Korea. Authorities stated the hackers laundered funds by converting them into Ethereum. articles.headline: Granules India reports 39 percent increase in quarterly net profit

articles.headline: Thousands in Israel urge Eisenkot-Arab deal

articles.summary: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Tel Aviv to pressure opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot into forming a coalition with Arab parties to unseat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. articles.description: In a counterprotest, Netanyahu supporters demand that Israel should not have a government with 'terrorists'.

articles.headline: Three killed in Manipur gunfight

The Kuki Inpi Manipur apex body strongly condemned the killings and alleged that Naga militant groups were responsible for the violent incident.
articles.description: Meanwhile, the Kuki Inpi Manipur (KIM), the apex body of the Kuki community, strongly condemned the killing of the three youths

articles.headline: Neocloud firms spark AI bubble fears
articles.title: These firms you've never heard of are feeding fears the AI bubble could burst
articles.summary: Neocloud data centre companies like CoreWeave and Nebius are facing investor scrutiny over heavy debt loads and financial stability as artificial intelligence spending forecasts fluctuate. Industry analysts warn that many independent operators could face acquisition or closure amid rising interest rates and heavy hardware costs, though demand for computing power from major artificial intelligence developers remains high.

articles.headline: HPE recommends measuring cost per merged pull request for AI coding
articles.title: Stop counting tokens, start counting what ships
articles.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise advises software developers to track cost per merged pull request rather than counting tokens to evaluate artificial intelligence investments accurately. According to the company, hybrid platforms routing routine tasks to on-premises open-weight models can reduce token costs by thirty to fifty percent while maintaining control over sensitive proprietary code repositories.
articles.description: When a developer gives an AI agent a coding task, the agent does more than answer once. It plans, generates code, runs tests, and repeats the process to correct errors. articles.headline: Vultr launches 20-megawatt AI supercluster in Chennai using AMD GPUs
articles.title: Vultr launches 20-MW AI supercluster in Chennai; aims 1 GW capacity by 2029
articles.summary: Cloud infrastructure provider Vultr announced the deployment of a twenty-megawatt artificial intelligence supercluster in Chennai, India, utilizing Advanced Micro Devices Instinct graphics processing units. articles.headline: Student movements and youth turnout unseat leaders in Serbia and Hungary

articles.headline: Jordanian King Abdullah vows firm response following Karak church attack
articles.title: Jordan’s King Abdullah promises to confront ‘terrorists’ after Karak attack
articles.summary: King Abdullah II of Jordan addressed parliament in Amman following a deadly church attack in Karak that killed nine people, pledging that the state will confront terrorism decisively. articles.description: King tells parliament attackers ‘are not of us’ and warns that Israeli expansionism is greatest threat to the region.

articles.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
articles.summary: United States District Judge Trina Thompson ordered the federal government to halt threats of criminal charges against local and state election officials processing ballots. articles.headline: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh outlines market opportunities amid challenging industry conditions

articles.summary: During his first in-person briefing on November 2, 2026, IndiGo Chief Executive Officer Willie Walsh stated that the airline sees significant growth prospects despite challenging industry conditions driven by rising fuel costs and rupee depreciation. articles.headline: Ryanair considers wage freeze and fare hikes amid rising fuel costs
articles.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
articles.summary: Irish carrier Ryanair is weighing temporary pay freezes for staff and higher European airfares to offset surging fuel costs. articles.headline: Yemeni government forces advance against Houthis in Al-Jawf governorate

articles.headline: Suspected cyberattacks cause overnight temperature spikes in European supermarket refrigeration
articles.title: Suspected cyberattacks trigger supermarket fridge failures across Europe
articles.summary: Supermarket refrigeration systems experienced unauthorized temperature increases across Belgium, Estonia, Ireland, Luxembourg, and Sweden following suspected cyberattacks. Retailers and officials reported that units were switched to defrost mode or elevated to fifty degrees Celsius, prompting European food and agriculture commissioner Christophe Hansen to condemn the incidents as deliberate disruption attempts.
articles.description: Temperature increases have been reported in dozens of store cooling systems , weeks after a similar attack in France.

articles.headline: Uganda begins troop withdrawal from Somalia after twenty years
articles.title: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after 20 years
articles.summary: Uganda started withdrawing Uganda People's Defence Forces troops from Mogadishu, handing security responsibilities to Somali forces. articles.headline: Indian stock indices surge nearly two percent driven by strong corporate earnings

articles.headline: No-cost Equated Monthly Instalments conceal hidden interest charges and inflated purchase prices.
articles.title: No-cost EMI: a loan that is portrayed as free

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh chief minister directs officials to prepare for cyclone floods

articles.headline: University of California researchers develop light-based technique to detect deepfakes

The suspects were intercepted at the Ganjal Toll Plaza in Nirmal district after fleeing in a stolen Tata Safari. Authorities recovered over nine lakh rupees in cash alongside gold and silver ornaments, with the total seized property valued at over one crore rupees.
articles.description: Nephew spoke to the victim at 11 p.m., when the latter said two people came to meet him. Later, the nephew received two voice notes warning him to not report the murder, said Yadadri-Bhongir SP

articles.headline: Mahadev betting app promoter Sourabh Chandrakar extradited from Oman to India
articles.title: Mahadev betting syndicate ‘kingpin’ extradited from Oman
articles.summary: Sourabh Chandrakar, promoter of the illegal Mahadev Online Book betting app, was extradited to India from Oman on November 1, 2026, according to a Central Bureau of Investigation spokesperson. Located by the Royal Oman Police following an Interpol Red Corner Notice, Chandrakar faces charges in cases filed by the Central Bureau of Investigation and the Enforcement Directorate regarding an alleged 6,000-crore-rupee scam.
articles.description: CBI says it secured extradition of Sourabh Chandrakar, who had been arrested by police in Oman following an Interpol Red Corner Notice

articles.headline: Exam system flaws resemble Soviet shoe factories
articles.title: What India’s leaky exam system can learn from Soviet shoe factories
articles.summary: Recent protests and legal challenges regarding leaked examination papers highlight ongoing vulnerabilities in India's testing systems without producing concrete preventive measures. The operational inefficiencies of testing authorities parallel Soviet-era shoe factories where lack of consumer demand incentives and rampant resource pilferage persisted without structural correction.
